0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000010_AYMERIC
0.description: To think the moogles would prove such harsh taskmasters! Forgive me, I did not know you had suffered so in your quest for the horn.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000020_AYMERIC
1.description: I must say, your spirited accounts always come as a welcome change from the arid reports which fill my days.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000030_AYMERIC
2.description: Though I have lived in these lands my entire life, to hear you speak of them, there is much and more I have yet to see. Truly, yours was a marvelous journey.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
4.description: Though perhaps a bit long for my liking.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
5.description: Why not join me on the next?

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
6.description: It wasn't all sunshine and lemoncakes.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000040_AYMERIC
7.description: Long <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> arduous, aye. Not unlike the journey that Ishgard has at last embarked upon─thanks to the efforts of you and yours.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000050_AYMERIC
8.description: Hah! Well...truth be told, when I think back on the sweeping vistas of the Churning Mists, I do feel some slight pangs of wanderlust...

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000060_AYMERIC
9.description: Alas, much as I would like to accept your invitation, I fear my present duties with the House of Lords demand my undivided attention. Someday, perhaps.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000070_AYMERIC
10.description: Nor would I presume to imply otherwise. Neither I nor any man alive can truly understand what you have endured, and I cannot say with any confidence that I would have acquitted myself as well under the circumstances─much less grown stronger for it.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000080_AYMERIC
11.description: By your deeds, you have helped us to lay the foundation for lasting reform.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000090_AYMERIC
12.description: The formation of the republic is but the beginning, for it is not only our system of governance which must needs change. We the people must learn to let go of our hatreds and rise above our bloody past.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000100_AYMERIC
13.description: I only pray that I live long enough to see us achieve some measure of success─that I might know the lost did not die in vain.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000110_AYMERIC
14.description: I can still see you there, on the Steps of Faith, striding fearlessly towards the wyrm... If you could do that, who are we to balk at the challenges ahead?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000120_AYMERIC
15.description: The question of how best to strengthen ties with the other great nations of Eorzea has been debated at length in the Lords and Commons of late.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000130_AYMERIC
16.description: As you may imagine, maintaining stability during this period of historic upheaval is our paramount concern. Nevertheless, we are greatly indebted to the Alliance for their support during the grand melee, and it would be remiss of us not to repay their faith in kind.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000140_AYMERIC
17.description: Of course, we owe you the greatest debt of all, and it is my hope that in extending our support to you and the Scions, we might also express our gratitude to our neighbors─nay, our fellow Eorzeans, whom we pray you will continue to protect.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000150_AYMERIC
18.description: The Lords and Commons agree on very little, but not a soul in either house begrudges your order this offer of patronage. For all you have done and will do, we thank you.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000170_AYMERIC
20.description: Now that the dust has settled, what will you do? Not as a Scion, I mean, but...what do you want for yourself?

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000180_MESSENGER02341
21.description: Lord Commander, pray forgive the interruption!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000200_MESSENGER02341
23.description: An urgent message for the Warrior of Light. I was instructed to deliver it without delay.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000210_MESSENGER02341
24.description: Master Thancred returned to the manor a short time ago, bearing an injured maiden.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000220_MESSENGER02341
25.description: Master Leveilleur and Mistress Tataru are tending to her wounds, but they like not her chances. Respectfully, my lord─they have requested the Warrior of Light's immediate presence.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000230_AYMERIC
26.description: You must go to them, my friend. And I shall go with you.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000240_PAPALYMO
27.description: For every ending marks a new beginning.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000250_PAPALYMO
28.description: From tragedy and sacrifice we rise to greet a new dawn. As did <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503>.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000260_PAPALYMO
29.description: Only to be drawn unto another battlefield, another cause, as if by fate...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000300_THANCRED
33.description: She ran afoul of the Warriors of Darkness.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000310_THANCRED
34.description: I had been tracking them since the ceremony at Falcon's Nest. Little did I know I was not the only one.

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000320_THANCRED
35.description: Evidently she had learned of their activities and attempted to shadow them on her own. Poorly.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000330_THANCRED
36.description: I rescued her in the Twelveswood, and together we fled north. But though I made every effort to cover our tracks, they caught up with us on the Ishgardian border, and in the ensuing struggle, Alisaie took an arrow to the shoulder.<hex:02100103>'Twas only after we had made good our escape that I realized it was poisoned...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000340_ALPHINAUD
37.description: Thank you for coming so quickly. And you, Ser Aymeric.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000350_AYMERIC
38.description: Think nothing of it. How is she?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000360_ALPHINAUD
39.description: We have done all we can for now. Although the immediate danger has passed, the poison yet lingers in her blood...

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000370_ALPHINAUD
40.description: We came to Eorzea together, hoping to bring salvation to the realm our grandfather gave his life to protect.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000380_ALPHINAUD
41.description: But when confronted with the bitter realities of its politics and its petty powermongers, she was driven to anger─and to doubt.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000390_ALPHINAUD
42.description: She refused to become embroiled in what she termed Eorzea's “squabbles,” and distanced herself from the Scions.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000400_ALPHINAUD
43.description: Though she remained hopeful of a brighter future, she would walk her own path. Would that it had not been so perilous...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000410_ALPHINAUD
44.description: For all our differences, she is as dedicated as any Scion to the salvation of Eorzea. But more than that, she is my sister...

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000420_ALPHINAUD
45.description: To be reunited with her, only to lose her forever... Gods, even to speak the words...

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000430_AYMERIC
46.description: Take heart, Master Alphinaud. She will be attended by our most skilled chirurgeons.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000440_AYMERIC
47.description: Bear Mistress Leveilleur to the infirmary at once. Apprise Captain Whitecape of the situation, and inform him that she is to be treated as my personal charge.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000450_ALISAIE
48.description: W-Wait... D-Don't go... Please, come closer...

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000460_ALISAIE
49.description: Alphinaud... Is the Warrior of Light... Is <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> with you? D-Don't go...there is something I must say...

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000470_ALISAIE
50.description: The Warriors of Darkness are in league with the Ascians... Slaughtering the primals is but the first step in their plan...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000480_ALISAIE
51.description: They make for Xelphatol to bring about Garuda's summoning... And to kill her...

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000490_ALISAIE
52.description: You must... You must stop them...

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000500_TATARU
53.description: I...I shall inform the others at once!

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000510_AYMERIC
54.description: Master Thancred─I would ask that you accompany Mistress Leveilleur to the infirmary. Your knowledge of her injuries may well prove useful in determining her treatment.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000540_ALPHINAUD
57.description: So they were unable to see the ritual to its completion... Then Garuda is no longer a threat, and whatever the Ascians and the Warriors of Darkness were planning has come to naught...

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000550_ALPHINAUD
58.description: But we should not tarry. The knights have secured our path to safety.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000560_PALADINOFDARKNESS
59.description: (-???-)Well, well... What do we have here? You'd better not have killed the primal without us!

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000580_BARDOFDARKNESS
61.description: Wait, I know you! Still walking, I see. I could have <hex:021A020203>sworn<hex:021A020103> my aim was true...

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000590_PALADINOFDARKNESS
62.description: Just what is your game? Leading us the long way, so these fools could step in and claim our prize?

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000600_WHITEMAGEOFDARKNESS
63.description: Now, now. Let's not make hasty accusations. By the look of things, the ritual was proceeding as planned.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000610_WHITEMAGEOFDARKNESS
64.description: We arrived at the appointed hour. 'Twas they who erred.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000620_ALPHINAUD
65.description: It is hopeless. We cannot face them all...

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000630_BARDOFDARKNESS
66.description: Do mine ears deceive? A <hex:021A020203>boy<hex:021A020103>! So <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> the way of it. Twins! You had me worried for a moment there.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000640_BARDOFDARKNESS
67.description: Know that I will happily make it quicker for you...if you just stand still.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000650_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
68.description: Enough, J'rhoomale. We wouldn't want to upset the man in white with any unnecessary bloodshed, now would we?

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000660_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
69.description: You've been awfully busy since we were kind enough to spare your lives.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000670_ALPHINAUD
70.description: While you were <hex:021A020203>idly<hex:021A020103> consorting with the Ascians, you mean? Seven hells! What could you possibly hope to achieve!?

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000680_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
71.description: Should I explain it to you? Very well. Consider it a reward of sorts for beating us here.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000690_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
72.description: You know the tale of Hydaelyn and Zodiark, I take it. Of the great sundering, and the reflections it created?

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000700_ALPHINAUD
73.description: Across ten and three they were divided. Reflections of the Source, each possessed of shards of Light and Dark...

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000710_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
74.description: Just so. One of those reflections─the one nearest to the Source─is our home. And we were the heroes blessed with Her Light.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000720_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
75.description: But not all worlds hold Light and Dark in equal measure. In ours, the power of Light was greater by far.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000730_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
76.description: So the Ascians who once threatened our home were no match, and they fell before us, one after another, till none were left. Victory, we thought...

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000740_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
77.description: ...And then came the Light─a flood of pure, blinding radiance, annihilating shadow and color and <hex:021A020203>life itself<hex:021A020103>. Ere long, it will consume our world, leaving naught in its wake but blank perfection.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000750_ALPHINAUD
78.description: That─ That cannot be! Do you honestly expect us to believe such a story!?

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000760_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
79.description: Believe what you like. But it has happened before, on a world far removed from ours. The Thirteenth, which was swallowed by the Dark, and transformed into what you call the void.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000770_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
80.description: Unchallenged Light would condemn us to a similar fate. And so we joined hands with our former enemies, and with their aid came here...to the Source.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000780_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
81.description: For there is but one way to restore the balance and save our home: the Ardor. Calamitous destruction with the power to break down the barriers between planes, and see our worlds rejoined.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000790_ALPHINAUD
82.description: You would doom our world to save your own!? What would even become of us? Of you?

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000810_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
84.description: You know our cause. You know what is at stake. We are prepared to do whatever it takes! Are you?

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000820_ALPHINAUD
85.description: If there is aught you would say, say it. Otherwise, begone. You have no friends here.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000840_ALISAIE
87.description: Well enough, Brother, thanks to the kindness of our hosts.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000850_ALISAIE
88.description: They told me you had departed for Xelphatol while I was still abed. I slept much better knowing that. Thank you.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000860_ALISAIE
89.description: When they told me you had departed for Xelphatol, I found that I could rest. The outcome seemed a mere formality, as did your safe return. Thank you, my friend.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000870_YSHTOLA
90.description: I take it your mission was a success?

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000880_THANCRED
91.description: ...As if we needed any further confirmation that they are in league with the Ascians.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000890_THANCRED
92.description: ...But to <hex:021A020203>save another world<hex:021A020103>? I think not.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000900_ALPHINAUD
93.description: I too thought his story fanciful at first. But it is possible there may be a kernel of truth in all of this. At the very least, none of his claims contradict the Word's account.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000910_YSHTOLA
94.description: You were following these people, Alisaie. Why?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000920_ALISAIE
95.description: During my travels, I had oft enjoyed tales of the Scions and their exploits. But after a time, I began to hear whispers of a gifted, and theretofore unknown, band of adventurers.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000930_ALISAIE
96.description: Adventurers who had supposedly sworn to travel the realm slaying primals in the Scions' stead.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000940_ALPHINAUD
97.description: The Warriors of Darkness... And in the course of investigating these rumors, you stumbled upon the Ascians' involvement.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000960_AYMERIC
99.description: Forgive me, but if these Warriors of Darkness mean to bring about another Calamity, to what end do they hunt primals?

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000970_ALISAIE
100.description: To prompt an escalation. To deepen the beast tribes' feelings of helplessness and despair, and thereby drive them to summon ever more powerful gods.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000980_ALISAIE
101.description: And lest we forget, these events do not occur in isolation. With their patron deities being slain left and right, the news of man's victory over Nidhogg must surely have sown panic in the minds of the beastmen. 'Tis no wonder they wish to defend themselves.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_000990_AYMERIC
102.description: Power answered with greater power, death with more death. A vicious cycle fueled by fear and hatred. I know its like all too well.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001000_ALISAIE
103.description: Indeed. The Ascians sow discord and desperation, and the Warriors of Darkness reap the harvest. And so it continues.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001010_ALISAIE
104.description: Yet that is not the extent of their ambitions. The Ascian himself observed that once the powerless realize that the old gods have failed them, they will have little recourse but to look to a new one.

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001030_THANCRED
106.description: It should come as no surprise, but Alisaie and I have uncovered evidence that the Ascians have been manipulating certain parties to ensure that a constant stream of crystals flows into the hands of the beast tribes.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001040_THANCRED
107.description: If we sever these supply lines, we should at least be able to slow the escalation.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001050_YSHTOLA
108.description: Agreed. Krile and I shall journey to Xelphatol and learn what we can of the Ixal's source.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001060_AYMERIC
109.description: Hm. Then I, for my part, pledge to lead a similar investigation into the origin of the Gnath's supply.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001080_AYMERIC
111.description: As a member of the Eorzean Alliance, Ishgard is honor-bound to play an active role in maintaining the security of the realm. You might also say that I have some personal motivation, given the Ascians' dealings with my father.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001090_AYMERIC
112.description: However, I make no secret of the fact that my knowledge of primal beings is scant at best. As such, I should be most grateful if one of your order were to assist me.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001100_THANCRED
113.description: Allow me, Ser Aymeric. I have dealt with the Gnath before.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001110_ALPHINAUD
114.description: Let us consult with Urianger, then. Given his dedication to the study of primal beings, I should be surprised if he could not tell us something of value.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001120_ALISAIE
115.description: Allow me to accompany you, Brother. And before you think to refuse, know that I am not the girl I once was. I shall not be a burden─you have my word.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001140_ALPHINAUD
117.description: ...You are more than welcome. After all, it was you who set us upon this path.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001150_TATARU
118.description: Wait a minute! I'm afraid I can't allow you to leave just yet─not until you try on the new outfit I prepared for you!

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001170_ALISAIE
120.description: Oh, it's you. Forgive me for straying from the camp.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001180_ALISAIE
121.description: He hasn't been feeling too welcome, to say the least. I thought a change of scenery might do him good, but, alas...

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001190_ALISAIE
122.description: It's so quiet out here. The stars spread out before us, beckoning across time and space...

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001200_ALISAIE
123.description: "Dawn may banish even the darkest night.“ How bitterly beautiful, those words.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001210_ALISAIE
124.description: I should be stronger for all my experiences, yet my heart aches more than ever.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001220_ALISAIE
125.description: I never understood why Grandfather gave his life that day. I thought that, if I came here, I would find the answers I needed. But when I finally laid eyes on the land he sacrificed everything to save, saw firsthand the bickering, the pettiness...

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001230_ALISAIE
126.description: I was disappointed. I was <hex:021A020203>angry<hex:021A020103>. I could not fathom how these people were more deserving of his love than his family...than me...

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001240_ALISAIE
127.description: Nevertheless, I had to believe he had good reason. I was determined to uncover the whole truth of the Calamity, and perhaps in so doing find my own purpose in this sea of chaos.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001250_ALISAIE
128.description: But when Grandfather revealed the whole truth of the Calamity to us, I finally understood. And I resolved there and then to continue his legacy in my own way.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001260_ALISAIE
129.description: My travels have been enlightening, but I cannot say that I have enjoyed them. I have lost count of the many petty crises that I was helpless to resolve, and of the people whose actions I could not understand.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001270_ALISAIE
130.description: There were others, of course. Good people. People with whom I felt a kinship...whose lives I could not save.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001280_ALISAIE
131.description: I found myself asking what it was all for. Why try if I was doomed to fail in the end? But then I recalled Grandfather's words to my father, years ago, before he left Sharlayan behind forever.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001290_ALISAIE
132.description: "To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom─it is indolence. We must all protect that which we hold most dear in the manner of our own choosing.“

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001300_ALISAIE
133.description: ...We have to try, do we not?

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001310_ALISAIE
134.description: Of course, it's one thing to try and another to do. There were times while I was tracking the Warriors of Darkness when I faltered─when I was afraid. But then I thought of my brother, of Urianger...

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001320_ALISAIE
135.description: Of course, it's one thing to try and another to do. There were times while I was tracking the Warriors of Darkness when I faltered─when I was afraid. But then I thought of my brother, of Urianger, of you...

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001330_ALISAIE
136.description: Ah, pray forgive me. This conversation has been rather one-sided, hasn't it. Mayhap you could recount some of your adventures in Ishgard?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
138.description: I traveled far and wide with two companions, Estinien and Ysayle, who were very...

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
139.description: Under some rather unique circumstances, I had the pleasure to fight alongside Ser Aymeric...

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
140.description: When Alphinaud and I came at last to the Dravanian hinterlands...

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001340_ALISAIE
141.description: Gods, they must have been at each other's throats from dawn till dusk...

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001350_ALISAIE
142.description: I daresay you managed to keep the peace, though. Merely being in the presence of the Warrior of Light is surely enough to shame <hex:021A020203>anyone<hex:021A020103> into behaving.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001360_ALISAIE
143.description: He is quite a man, the lord commander. I shall have to thank him for his kindness. Truth be told, I was rather taken aback by it all. Given Ishgard's famous love of foreigners, I was half expecting the chirurgeons to berate me for bleeding.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001370_ALISAIE
144.description: But I never heard an unkind word. Everyone there seemed relatively open and friendly, in fact─thanks in no small part to your tireless efforts, I suspect.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001380_ALISAIE
145.description: We had no clear memories of our life in the hinterlands, having returned to the motherland as infants. Nevertheless, I am quite familiar with Master Matoya, as is every Sharlayan. I should like to speak with her someday.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001390_ALISAIE
146.description: 'Twould not surprise me if Alphinaud's recent maturation was at least somewhat due to her sage guidance. I would never tell him this, of course, but there have been moments when I've caught myself thinking of him as an <hex:021A020203>elder brother<hex:021A020103>...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001400_ALISAIE
147.description: The hopes and dreams of so many rest on your shoulders, Warrior of Light.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001410_ALISAIE
148.description: As long as the sun rises, we can but carry on. For the sake of those we hold dear.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001420_URIANGER
149.description: To what end dost thou cling to the tainted gifts of the Mother?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001430_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
150.description: Every tool has its purpose. Even this.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001450_URIANGER
152.description: The seeds sown in Vylbrand have been plucked from the earth and left to wither.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001460_URIANGER
153.description: Alas, Titan's demise sufficed not to drive the kobolds to deepest desperation.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001470_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
154.description: What did the man in white have to say?

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001480_URIANGER
155.description: That we are to proceed as he did first set forth.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001490_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
156.description: Well that's easy for him to say! It's not <hex:021A020203>his<hex:021A020103> bloody world on the brink of destruction, is it!?

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001500_URIANGER
157.description: Be thou well reminded that with an end to Ishgard's unrest, naught now remaineth to preoccupy the Scions' thoughts. And thus may they devote their every energy to thwarting thee and thine. I foresee only greater difficulties ahead.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001510_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
158.description: Foresee? Are you sure you don't <hex:021A020203>welcome them<hex:021A020103>? I'm starting to think you might hold a candle for your old friends, after all...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001520_URIANGER
159.description: Pray do not mistake mine intent. I but look upon the path which lieth before us with due trepidation.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001530_URIANGER
160.description: Shouldst thou be of like mind, pray consider, then, another course, for the power to invoke the Ardor belongeth not unto the Ascians alone.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001540_URIANGER
161.description: With thine own hand, strike down thine enemy─the so-called hero who would see thy home lost to Light. Do but this and thou wouldst, at a single stroke, disrupt the all too delicate balance of this realm, plunging her straightways into chaos.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001550_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
162.description: You do realize what you're suggesting, yes?

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001560_URIANGER
163.description: "To ignore the plight of those one might conceivably save is not wisdom─it is indolence.“ The words of my teacher, and a creed I hold close to my heart.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001570_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
164.description: Very well. Draw <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> out. We'll make it quick.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001590_URIANGER
166.description: What good a creed one cannot uphold? What hurts soothed, what lives saved... O hapless fool, what hast thou wrought by thine own hands?

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001600_URIANGER
167.description: Minfilia, my friends─I shall not now beg your forgiveness.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001610_URIANGER
168.description: Full deeply though it paineth me to walk it, I shall not stray from my chosen path. As Moenbryda remained steadfast, so too shall I...

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001620_IRONMASK
169.description: Brothers and sisters... Twenty years ago, Ala Mhigo, our home, was claimed by the Garlean Empire.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001630_IRONMASK
170.description: In our haste to overthrow the King of Ruin, we turned a blind eye to our foes in the north. With our glorious revolution, we but laid a path for a new tyrant to succeed the old...and when confronted with our failure, we fled.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001640_IRONMASK
171.description: Not a day goes by that I do not think of those we left behind─think of them, and feel ashamed. And I know each and every one of you feels the same.

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001650_IRONMASK
172.description: We abandoned them, our own flesh and blood, to labor till their backs gave in and their breath gave out, building the twisted steel ramparts which now mar our once majestic mountains.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001660_IRONMASK
173.description: We abandoned them, the brave and true, to fight and die for their country─or worse, to be conscripted and sent off to rob another poor bastard of his home.

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001670_IRONMASK
174.description: We abandoned them, the meek and powerless, to bow and scrape when the Garleans pass─to sully themselves that they might live to see another day of misery.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001680_IRONMASK
175.description: The Black Wolf may be dead, but a new imperial viceroy reigns in Ala Mhigo now. A beast not a fraction as merciful.

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001690_IRONMASK
176.description: You all know the Eorzean Alliance will do naught to oppose him. For all their promises and platitudes, they will not act if there's no profit in it. Only <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> can free our brothers and sisters from the Empire's tyranny, my friends! Only we have the courage to stand and fight!

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001700_IRONMASK
177.description: They have imprisoned us, they have enslaved us, and they have murdered us─but no more! Blood demands blood, and the Garleans shall pay for every drop they have spilt upon our lands!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001710_IRONMASK
178.description: This I promise you, for we have a power within us, my friends─a power befitting our pride, our righteousness! Only join us, and we shall grant you the means to unleash it, and together we shall see the Ala Mhigan standard raised over the mountains of Gyr Abania once more!

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001720_ALPHINAUD
179.description: "A power befitting their pride...“ Not at all ominous, that.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001740_YDA
181.description: <gasp> What are you two doing here!?

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001750_ALPHINAUD
182.description: I could ask you the same thing!

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001760_PAPALYMO
183.description: Well, well, this is quite the surprise.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001770_PAPALYMO
184.description: Might I suggest we continue this conversation in more...<hex:021A020203>agreeable<hex:021A020103> surroundings?

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001780_IRONMASK
185.description: If you see what I see, if you feel as I feel, then I bid you join us! And those of you who cannot fight, fear not. For it is not strength of arms that will win this battle, but strength of heart!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001800_IRONMASK
187.description: You must be the esteemed adventurers of whom I have heard so much. I understand you have taken an interest in our cause.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001820_ALPHINAUD
189.description: Your words have certainly made quite an impression on my friend and I. The Resistance has long─and some would say wisely─avoided open engagements with the Garleans, but you and yours seem confident against the world in arms.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001830_ALPHINAUD
190.description: I can only assume you have good reason to be so bold. Why, one might even think you were planning to summon a primal.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001840_ALPHINAUD
191.description: Because that would do much to explain the sizable shipment of crystals you recently received from your smuggler friends─whom our Ishgardian allies have since detained, lest you wonder.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001850_YDA
192.description: I'd like to hear more about the Griffin. The <hex:021A020203>real<hex:021A020103> Griffin. Your performance earlier didn't fool us!

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001860_IRONMASK
193.description: Ah. The famous Scions of the Seventh Dawn. I should have known better than to think I could conceal the truth from you lot.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001870_IRONMASK
194.description: (-The False Griffin-)You are right. I am not the Griffin. But I speak with his voice, and it was at his behest that we procured those crystals.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001880_IRONMASK
195.description: (-The False Griffin-)You are wrong, however, if you think that we procured them to summon a primal.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001890_IRONMASK
196.description: (-The False Griffin-)We used them to reach an accord with the Amalj'aa. In exchange for crystals to summon their god, they will aid us in the fight for Ala Mhigan liberation.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001900_YDA
197.description: You've got to be joking! Have you gone completely mad!?

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001910_YDA
198.description: When people find out you helped the lizardmen summon Ifrit, they'll turn on the Resistance! Ala Mhigo will never be free!

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001920_IRONMASK
199.description: (-The False Griffin-)This isn't a faerie tale, girl. We don't have the luxury to play at being honorable heroes.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001930_IRONMASK
200.description: (-The False Griffin-)It's because the likes of you wouldn't sully your saintly hands that Ala Mhigo's been under the yoke for the past twenty years! But the Griffin won't stand for it, and neither will we! We're ready to do whatever it takes!

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001940_PAPALYMO
201.description: What proof do you have of this arrangement with the Amalj'aa?

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001950_IRONMASK
202.description: (-The False Griffin-)What, aside from a lack of crystals? None. But the beastmen have a great big pile of the things, if you fancy looking. You might want to hurry, though─it'll not be long before they summon their god.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001960_IRONMASK
203.description: (-The False Griffin-)Search our camp if you don't believe me. We have naught to hide.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001970_PAPALYMO
204.description: If there is a cache to be found, Yda and I will find it.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001980_IRONMASK
205.description: (-The False Griffin-)Then let us be off.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_001990_IRONMASK
206.description: (-The False Griffin-)Are you perchance the Warrior of Light?

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002000_IRONMASK
207.description: (-The False Griffin-)Aye, I thought so. You should know that a great many who have joined us did so because you saved them─because you showed them that one brave <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> can make a difference.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002010_IRONMASK
208.description: (-The False Griffin-)You saved me too, once. Helped a friend over in Quarrymill make some medicine I needed. But that was a lifetime ago...

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002020_IRONMASK
209.description: (-The False Griffin-)On behalf of my brothers and sisters, I thank you. You gave us hope where there was none; courage and strength when all was lost. We shall not squander your gift.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002030_PAPALYMO
210.description: I know that look, Yda, and I do not like it. You cannot seriously be contemplating taking up arms with that band of cutthroats?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002050_PAPALYMO
212.description: If the Griffin and his men have their way, it is only a matter of time before the situation in Ala Mhigo comes to a head.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002060_PAPALYMO
213.description: Your homeland's future teeters on a knife-edge, and any reckless action, however small, could have irrevocable consequences.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002070_PAPALYMO
214.description: You mustn't lose sight of that, Yda. When the time comes, we must all make our choices, but we must do so in full possession of the facts. Now let us away─there is work to be done.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002080_THANCRED
215.description: This isn't right. The Amalj'aa would never leave this place so poorly guarded.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002100_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
217.description: Hah hah! Ahhh, the saviors of Eorzea. Slow as ever.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002110_ALPHINAUD
218.description: By the Twelve... Will you never learn?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002120_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
219.description: You know, you're right. Mayhap it <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> time for a change of tack. Killing primals, tormenting beastmen, hastening the birth of a new god...

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002130_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
220.description: It's all a bit much, isn't it? And, frankly, we don't have the leisure to do it.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002140_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
221.description: Killing the Warrior of Light, on the other hand─that would <hex:021A020203>soon<hex:021A020103> plunge Eorzea into chaos.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002150_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
222.description: One life for one world. A fair exchange─wouldn't you agree!?

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002160_THANCRED
223.description: Lest you forget, you've more than one opponent!

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002180_BARDOFDARKNESS
225.description: I sense you will offer more than mere target practice. Unlike your sister.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002200_ALISAIE
227.description: Did...did I not tell you, Alphinaud? I am not the girl I once was.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002210_ALISAIE
228.description: My brother was always the clever one, while my talents lay elsewhere...

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002220_ALISAIE
229.description: If you would dare to stand against us, to destroy all that we hold dear, then you shall die by my sword!

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002230_ALISAIE
230.description: As Eorzea's blade of Light once stood by my side, now I shall stand at <hex:02080EE905FF0568657273FF0468697303>─and defend this realm with all my might!

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002280_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
235.description: You <hex:021A020203>snake<hex:021A020103>. You would betray us as well?

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002290_URIANGER
236.description: He that holdeth fast unto his convictions shall never count betrayal amongst his crimes, though all the world may call him villain. My path is unchanged; my creed sacrosanct. This I believe with all my heart.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002300_URIANGER
237.description: But say, Warrior of Darkness, and speak true─what dost <hex:021A020203>thou<hex:021A020103> believe? That rendering up the souls of thy world in service to the Rejoining will grant it salvation? Nay.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002320_URIANGER
239.description: Mine apologies, Master Alphinaud. That the brightest light might shine, duty did compel me to walk in darkest shade.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002330_ALISAIE
240.description: You sweet fool. I was almost willing to believe you had turned against us.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002340_ALISAIE
241.description: I expect a full explanation when this is over. For now, may I assume you have turned your cloak for the last time?

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002370_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
244.description: Even odds, then. No matter. We'll crush the lot of you in one fell swoop!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002390_ALISAIE
246.description: Hearken to me! We only have one chance!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002400_ALISAIE
247.description: Channel your aether into my blade that I might strike before the mage casts his spell!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002410_ALISAIE
248.description: I cannot do it alone, but together...together we can defeat them!

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002440_ALISAIE
251.description: A touch dizzy, but otherwise fine. Thank you.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002450_THANCRED
252.description: And there you have it. Our friend is too stubborn to die.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002460_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
253.description: Hmph. We are far from finished.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002470_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
254.description: Or have you never considered how we came to this world?

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002490_URIANGER
256.description: Just so. As the Ascians flee unto the rift 'twixt planes with Crystals of Darkness, so did these warriors come hither with Crystals of Light.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002500_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
257.description: Eloquent, as always. Aye, like the Ascians, we too are beyond death! You cannot defeat that which is eternal!

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002530_ALPHINAUD
260.description: Such methods as the Ascians employ require the renunciation of the flesh. You...you would have had to...

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002540_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
261.description: At long last, you see. To save our world, we gave our lives.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002550_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
262.description: We were just adventurers trying to make our way. An odd job here, a favor there─we never aspired to be Warriors of Light.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002560_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
263.description: But word of our deeds spread, and soon people were calling us heroes. They placed their hopes and dreams on our shoulders and bid us fight for all that was good and right.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002570_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
264.description: We fought and we fought and we fought...until there was no one left to fight. We <hex:021A020203>won<hex:021A020103>...and now our world is being erased from existence.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002580_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
265.description: We did <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> right, everything that was asked of us, and still─<hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> it came to this!

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002590_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
266.description: You of all people should understand! We cannot─we <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> not falter. We brought our world to the brink of destruction, and now we must save it.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002600_PALADINOFDARKNESS
267.description: I've died before, Arbert. I'm not afraid to die again.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002610_WHITEMAGEOFDARKNESS
268.description: No matter how many times we fall, we must rise and carry on the fight. For those we left behind.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002620_URIANGER
269.description: To have known the depths of sorrow and embrace the highest sacrifice─nonetheless...Master Louisoix, guide my hand, I pray you, as fate's thread spinneth upon this most capricious spindle.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002630_URIANGER
270.description: Quickly! Thou must needs invoke the power of thy crystal!

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002650_MINFILIA
272.description: Such pain... Such sorrow... Oh, my dear children...

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002670_URIANGER
274.description: Mother Hydaelyn, hearken unto Your children's plea! From two worlds do we gather, and from two worlds do we offer a bounty of Light.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002680_URIANGER
275.description: In this desperate hour, we do beseech Your intercession! We beg an audience with the Word of the Mother─with Your chosen, Minfilia!

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002690_MINFILIA
276.description: Your cries go not unheard... Nor your sacrifices unnoticed...

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002700_MINFILIA
277.description: Though many are lost, there are those we can yet save... Whom I can yet save...

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002720_MINFILIA
279.description: Blessed children of the First. The light of your world hath grown blinding in its radiance, but it is not yet absolute.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002730_MINFILIA
280.description: I will hie me to your world and there take unto myself the Light which riseth even now to drown it, as Darkness once did drown another.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002740_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
281.description: <hex:021A020203>Now<hex:021A020103> you deign to answer our prayers!? I will suffer this farce no longer!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002750_MINFILIA
282.description: (-Minfilia-)As the Ascians must serve as instruments of Zodiark's will, so too must others carry out the will of Hydaelyn.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002760_MINFILIA
283.description: (-Minfilia-)But for the boon you have granted Her, She has grown strong enough to set me free, that I might serve as Her emissary.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002770_MINFILIA
284.description: (-Minfilia-)Your suffering, your sacrifice, your supplications─She has heard all. We will not let the First fall to Light.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002780_MINFILIA
285.description: (-Minfilia-)Thank you, Urianger, for bringing everyone here. It fills my heart with joy to look upon the faces of my friends once more.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002790_URIANGER
286.description: In taking you unto Her bosom, I knew that Hydaelyn had bequeathed to you a sliver of Her grace, granting you strength long sought.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002800_URIANGER
287.description: And in treating with the Ascians, I learned of a star like unto our own─a doomed world of fallen heroes, in whom I glimpsed ourselves. The First.

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002810_URIANGER
288.description: Full long did I search for a means to save this world, concluding at the last that the answer lay in the power of blessed crystals. And thus did I labor to set Light against Dark.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002820_URIANGER
289.description: Yet I knew from the beginning that this salvation would not come without sacrifice, for the instrument of the First's deliverance would of necessity be required to journey thither...there to remain, mayhap forever.

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002830_ALPHINAUD
290.description: You orchestrated all of this not to save her, but to send her away!?

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002840_URIANGER
291.description: One life for one world. Such was the bargain, and you the coin, though it were not mine to spend.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002850_MINFILIA
292.description: (-Minfilia-)Have we not walked together in the light of the Crystal, and at Her bidding borne witness to the joys and sorrows of this land? Each and every one of you knows my heart. If this be the price I must pay, I pay it gladly.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002870_MINFILIA
294.description: (-Minfilia-)My dearest Thancred... You who have ever watched over me... I am truly grateful for all you have done on my behalf, as would my father be.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002880_MINFILIA
295.description: (-Minfilia-)Your kindness, your compassion, your love... These are your gifts to me, and our gifts to them, forming a bond which transcends time and space.

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002890_THANCRED
296.description: Sometimes I forget you are not the child I once knew. Make me proud.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002900_MINFILIA
297.description: (-Minfilia-)Long have I watched you from Hydaelyn's side. Watched as you nurtured and kept safe the light of the dawn.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002910_MINFILIA
298.description: (-Minfilia-)The dark recesses of the world hide untold secrets and dangers. Thus do I entrust to you Tupsimati. I pray you keep to the path that you may never have need of it.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002920_BLACKMAGEOFDARKNESS
299.description: 'Twould seem the power of our crystals is all but spent. Perhaps...if there is naught else to be done...

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002930_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
300.description: Hear me, servant of Hydaelyn. If you would have us place our trust in you, then I would ask a favor.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002940_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
301.description: Take us with you. Take us home.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002950_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
302.description: We were blind to the truth once. So I tell you this, as one fool to another. Light, Dark, it doesn't matter. What matters is how you choose to use them.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002960_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
303.description: We made our choice, and you see what came of it. So please...forge a different path. Seize a better fate.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002970_MINFILIA
304.description: (-Minfilia-)'Tis a strange feeling. So many times have I watched you depart, my heart filled with worry, and ever did you return to me in triumph.

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_002980_MINFILIA
305.description: (-Minfilia-)Someday, when I have found a way to free this star from Her sorrow, I promise you I shall repay the favor.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003000_YDA
307.description: Back in the solar! It's been too long since we were all together like this. Not since...not since after Moenbryda...

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003010_PAPALYMO
308.description: Much has changed since then─we ourselves most of all.

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003020_ALPHINAUD
309.description: Though not all who were lost could be gathered here today, we may take comfort in the knowledge that those who are not are carrying on the fight.

310.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003030_TATARU
310.description: While I am grateful to our friends in the north for their hospitality...it isn't half-good to be back!

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003040_ALPHINAUD
311.description: But, as Papalymo rightly said, much has changed since we last stood here. The Scions of the Seventh Dawn are not as they once were. Nor should we be.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003050_ALPHINAUD
312.description: Our travels in the north brought us into contact with a host of fine and generous people, and their selfless deeds served to show me that it is not lofty causes that should inform our actions, but our hearts.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003060_ALPHINAUD
313.description: And I hope that the Scions might continue in this manner: as individuals driven by individual principles. Provided we all sincerely desire to work towards Eorzea's salvation, I believe the paths we follow to achieve it need not─and should not─be dictated by any single ideal.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003070_YSHTOLA
314.description: Companions bound by a common purpose, free to go whither they will... The idea is not without merit.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003080_YSHTOLA
315.description: Very well. I shall resume my research of the primals and the elder gods of Eorzea. Should anyone have need of my findings, you need only ask.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003090_YSHTOLA
316.description: I should be glad of your continued assistance.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003100_KRILE
317.description: Well, my main purpose in coming here was to see the Scions of the Seventh Dawn restored and my dear friend found...

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003110_KRILE
318.description: Nevertheless, having involved myself in your struggles, I feel compelled to see them through to the bitter end. For Minfilia's sake. That is, if there are no objections?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003120_ALPHINAUD
319.description: You will always be welcome here, Krile.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003130_THANCRED
320.description: Urianger, can we trust you to carry on your investigation of the Ascians as before?

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003140_URIANGER
321.description: Regardless of mine own desires, I am undeserving of your trust, having so villainously deceived you all.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003150_THANCRED
322.description: Now, now, I'll hear no more of that. 'Twould be disrespectful of Minfilia's wishes.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003160_THANCRED
323.description: She entrusted matters here to us, that we might protect this star and understand the truth which hides at Her heart. Mayhap I can handle the former, but I think you far better suited to the latter, no?

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003170_URIANGER
324.description: Very well. Then out of love for my lady Minfilia and Moenbryda both, this shall be my solemn charge.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003180_YDA
325.description: I... <hex:021A020203>Papalymo and I<hex:021A020103> should probably return to Thanalan to keep an eye on the Resistance.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003190_YDA
326.description: There's still the matter of the Griffin and the Amalj'aa, not to mention the new imperial viceroy. That little lot must be worthy of our attention, right?

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003200_ALPHINAUD
327.description: And what will you do, Alisaie?

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003210_ALISAIE
328.description: You know I have no great love for organizations and formalities.

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003220_ALISAIE
329.description: That being said...this new approach you propose is not wholly objectionable. And we've always got <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> to keep us from bickering.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003230_ALISAIE
330.description: But I will suffer no titles. I am not here for House Leveilleur, nor to walk in Grandfather's shadow.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003240_ALPHINAUD
331.description: Upon that point, we see eye to eye. If it please you, you may think of me as but another comrade-in-arms.

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003250_TATARU
332.description: Well then, <hex:021A020203>Alphy<hex:021A020103>─I, for my part, shall see to the paperwork and the finances with my characteristic aplomb.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003260_ALPHINAUD
333.description: I would not have it any other way, Tataru.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003270_ALPHINAUD
334.description: And we mustn't forget you. What now for the Warrior of Light?

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
338.description: To strive for those we have lost. For those we can yet save.

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003290_YSHTOLA
341.description: The path behind us was fraught with hardship, and the path before us will be no less unforgiving. But a new dawn <hex:021A020203>shall<hex:021A020103> break over the realm, and I see before me the faces of those who will deliver it.

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003300_PAPALYMO
342.description: One world's heroes are another world's villains. One world's loss another world's gain.

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003310_PAPALYMO
343.description: "Where men go as one, there is life... And where there is life...“

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003320_PAPALYMO
344.description: My friends. If I may, I would ask that you entrust Tupsimati to me.

345.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003330_PAPALYMO
345.description: Clouds gather upon the horizon, and as Master Louisoix's disciple, I would keep it close at hand.

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003340_PAPALYMO
346.description: Thank you. I shall guard it well.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03400_003360_PAPALYMO
348.description: For every ending, every parting, marks a new beginning.
